records.title: Ring of the Night
records.howToGet: Awarded for seeing the Past Glory questline through and thwarting Xanthe's scheme.
records.summary: A vampirism ring that feeds the blood pool from four directions at once and trims vampire ability cooldowns.
bodyParagraphs: Every line on this ring points at the blood economy. It raises how much blood a feed returns, adds blood at each time segment, ticks a slow regeneration on top, and shaves a little off vampire ability cooldowns.

Guide writers consistently pick it as the specialist choice for a night-leaning, vampirism-heavy character, in the same breath that they name Slicer's Ring for claw builds, Astrologer's Ring for witchcraft and Ring of Quick Strikes for conventional weapons.
It comes out of the Past Glory questline rather than open-world looting, so it is tied to story progress rather than exploration.

records.title: Ring of Quick Strikes
records.howToGet: Sits in a chest inside an abandoned ruin that only opens up during The Highland Grave quest.
records.summary: Legendary ring for sword-and-steel builds, stacking weapon damage, critical chance and critical damage with a little physical mitigation.
bodyParagraphs: This is the straightforward damage ring for players who stay on conventional weapons rather than claws or spells. Sources describe it as lifting weapon damage, critical hit chance and critical hit damage together, with a modest amount of physical damage reduction attached.
The ruin that holds it is gated behind The Highland Grave quest, so it cannot simply be stumbled into while exploring.
Exact percentage values were not stated in any source I could reach, so no numbers are recorded here.
records.note: Sources agree on which stats it raises but none of the ones I could read gave the actual percentages.

records.title: Astrologer's Ring
records.howToGet: Finish the Home Sweet Home quest at Aurelius Tower and survive Aurelius' looping dream.
records.summary: The witchcraft specialist's ring, raising spell damage, activation charge and charge regeneration while cutting cooldowns.
bodyParagraphs: Guides treat this as the ring to build a witchcraft character around. It raises the damage of witchcraft abilities, shortens their cooldowns, and improves both your activation charge pool and how quickly that pool refills on its own.
Getting it means completing Home Sweet Home at Aurelius Tower, which involves surviving the dream loop Aurelius traps you in.
Recommendation lists commonly pair it with the Relic of St Dasius for a full witchcraft loadout.

records.title: Knightly Ring
records.howToGet: Take a shovel from the wooden shed in Parlita, fast travel to the Tantari Bog shrine, cross the small wooden bridge east and dig the mound of dirt just past it. It is also listed as the payoff for Bandit's Treasure Map: Tantari Woods.
records.summary: An early-reachable legendary ring that speeds up swordmastery cooldowns and charge recovery while adding magical and physical mitigation.
bodyParagraphs: The appeal is the turnaround speed: swordmastery abilities come back faster and activation charges refill quickly after you land an attack, with damage reduction against both magical and physical hits layered on top.

Digging it up is possible at any level, but Coen cannot actually wear it until level 9, which makes it a reward worth fetching early and slotting later. A Tatzelwurm patrols near the dig site, so clearing or avoiding it first is advised.
Its stat card carries the flavour line about trusting your blade and your honour.

records.title: Slicer's Ring
records.howToGet: Bought from Sanzhana once the Pearly and Precious and Good Home side quests are done; her special stock only appears after you reach level 3 of Bewitching Influence.
records.summary: A claw-focused night build ring that raises critical performance and overall damage while returning some activation charge.
bodyParagraphs: Where Ring of Quick Strikes serves swords, Slicer's Ring serves claws. Guides describe it as improving critical performance and general damage output, with a slice of activation charge restoration attached.
Unlocking the purchase is a two-step chore: clear both Pearly and Precious and Good Home, then push Bewitching Influence to level 3 so Sanzhana's special offers become visible.

records.title: Corrupted Ring
records.summary: A night build ring that grows the vampiric health pool, softens the cost of vampire abilities and adds damage against mortals.
bodyParagraphs: Four things are attributed to this ring: more vampiric health, a reduced penalty for casting vampire abilities, extra health regeneration, and higher damage dealt to mortal enemies. That combination makes it a night-side counterpart to the more conventional damage rings.
I could not find a stated location or acquisition method for it in any source available to me, and no numeric values were given.

records.title: Quick Fighter's Ring
records.howToGet: Bring the cursed ring from The Ring quest to Anca at the Crossroads Inn; she destroys it and hands this over. Databases also list it as a world drop across six regions and stock at many merchants.
records.summary: Epic survivability ring from The Ring quest, adding twelve percent to both maximum health and health restoration plus a small sword cooldown cut.
bodyParagraphs: This is the reward branch of The Ring where you let Anca destroy the cursed band rather than keeping it. The replacement she gives is a straightforward survivability piece: more maximum health, faster health restoration, and a small reduction to the sword skill cooldown multiplier.

Item databases also record it turning up in six separate world locations, among them Maragir Wealds, Laslea Glen, Svartrau City and Rockfalls, and being stocked by a long list of merchants including the Butcher Vendor, the Captive Vendor, the Catalin Supply Man and guard post traders.
The rarity tier is recorded as Epic in the databases, which is a finer-grained scale than this site's three-step rarity field, so it is stored as a stat instead.

records.title: Ring of Regeneration
records.howToGet: A common world drop across six regions and widely stocked by merchants, including the Butcher Vendor, the Captive Vendor, the Catalin Supply Man and guard post traders.
records.summary: A cheap, widely available Superior ring giving a six percent bump to health restoration.
bodyParagraphs: This is the entry-level version of the health-restoration ring line, sitting well below Loop of Vitality and Quick Fighter's Ring in strength but far easier to obtain.

Databases record it appearing in six world locations, among them Maragir Wealds, Laslea Glen, Svartrau City and Rockfalls, and being carried by around sixteen different merchants, which makes it the ring most players will see first.
records.note: One guide describes the bonus as health regeneration while the item database labels it Human Health Restoration. Both state six percent, so only the wording differs.

records.title: Soul Reaping Manual
records.howToGet: Clear the Ancient Circle in the woods east of Maragir, which only activates in daylight and starts a fight when you touch the central altar. A second copy waits at the River Massacre Site east of Svartrau once its ghosts are put down, and three witchcraft vendors stock it.
records.summary: The witchcraft manual for Soul Reaping, available free from two world sites and from every witchcraft vendor.
bodyParagraphs: Soul Reaping is widely called the strongest witchcraft option in the game because it curses an enemy with damage over time while healing you for as long as the curse runs, which solves the sustain problem for a human-form build.

There are two free copies. The first is an Ancient Circle in the woods east of Maragir that can only be activated during the day; interacting with the stone altar in the middle triggers a fight, and clearing it yields the manual. The second is the River Massacre Site east of Svartrau, which pays out once every ghost haunting the camp is destroyed.

If you would rather buy it, Vera, Mevasser and the Uriashi Matriarch all sell witchcraft manuals, Soul Reaping included. The Matriarch's shop in Uriash Village opens after Song of the Mountain and carries very nearly the full witchcraft manual list.

records.title: Ravenous Flock Manual
records.howToGet: Reward for the Pilgrimage of Power: Bear Trouble quest, west across the river from the Laslea Gate shrine in Laslea Glen.
records.summary: The witchcraft manual for Ravenous Flock, earned by completing the Bear Trouble pilgrimage in Laslea Glen.
bodyParagraphs: Ravenous Flock sends a burst of ravens into a cone in front of Coen, damaging and stunning whatever is caught in it.

The manual comes from Pilgrimage of Power: Bear Trouble, which starts directly west across the river from the Laslea Gate shrine. Follow the wind chimes and cairns up the mountain trail, kill the Ravenous Bear waiting at the summit, then examine the body and the bloodied knife on the west side of the clearing before inspecting the uriash glyph carved into the central stone. The glyph is what actually hands over the manual.
The Pilgrimage of Power quests are one of the three reliable manual sources for witchcraft, alongside Ancient Circles and Haunted Sites.

bodyParagraphs: Life Lock blocks a single instance of damage and reflects it at whoever dealt it, which makes the manual worth hunting for a defensive witchcraft build.

records.title: Recipe for Razkovniche Elixir
records.howToGet: Pinned to the north-western wall inside the dead alchemist's house during The Hedgehog Herb side quest.
records.summary: The one-off recipe behind the game's permanent health elixir, found on an alchemist's wall during The Hedgehog Herb.
bodyParagraphs: This is the recipe players are most often pointed at, because the elixir it makes is the only consumable in the game with a permanent effect. The catch is the Razkovniche Plant: the Hedgehog Herb quest is the only source, so the elixir can be brewed exactly once per playthrough.
The other two components are repeatable by comparison. Strong Ancient Reagent comes out of Ancient Ruins and Tatzelwurm Glands come off dead Tatzelwurms.
Once you hold the recipe and the parts, Coen, Anca or a medic can each perform the brewing.

records.title: Razkovniche Elixir
records.howToGet: Craft it yourself, or have Anca or a medic do it, once you hold the recipe and its three components. It can only ever be made once.
records.summary: The game's only permanent consumable, granting a lasting health increase in both forms plus a free skill point.
bodyParagraphs: Everything else you brew wears off. This does not: it permanently raises maximum human health by a fifth and maximum vampiric health by a tenth, and hands over a skill point on top.
Because the Razkovniche Plant only exists inside The Hedgehog Herb quest, there is no way to repeat it. Guides accordingly treat the quest as effectively mandatory for anyone optimising a run.
The crafting step can be delegated: Coen, Anca and a medic are all listed as able to prepare it.

records.title: Minor Mending Ointment
records.howToGet: Known from the start of the game. Gather two Ribwort Plantain on the rocky slopes north-east of Hustia Glen and buy a Canteen of Water from Rainer the food vendor in the village.
records.summary: The starting health item and the game's crafting tutorial, restoring a small amount of health instantly.
bodyParagraphs: This is the one recipe Coen already knows when crafting unlocks, and making it is how the game teaches the crafting panel. Its effect is a small instant health restore.
The two components are deliberately easy: Ribwort Plantain grows on the rocky slopes north-east of Hustia Glen, and Rainer, the village food vendor, sells the Canteen of Water.
It sits at the bottom of the ointment line. Ointments in general are the instant-restore family, distinct from salves, which heal over time, and balms, which raise maximum health.

records.title: Vigour Infusion
records.summary: A stamina consumable that enlarges the maximum stamina pool rather than refilling it.
bodyParagraphs: Stamina crafting splits two ways, and Vigour Infusion is the half that raises the ceiling: it increases how much stamina you can hold. Revitalising Tonic is the other half, speeding up the refill rate instead.
Stamina is the smallest crafting category in the game at six recipes. Exact values and the ingredient list were not stated in any source I could reach.
Crafted consumables keep their full strength in combat, unlike food, whose effects are reduced once a fight starts.
records.note: The guides describe the effect in general terms only; no numbers, ingredients or tiers were published in anything I could read.

records.title: Revitalising Tonic
records.summary: A stamina consumable that speeds up how fast stamina refills.
bodyParagraphs: Where Vigour Infusion makes the stamina bar bigger, Revitalising Tonic makes it come back faster. Between them they cover the six stamina recipes in the crafting list.

Guides refer to these in the plural, which points at the pattern running through the whole recipe list: most consumables exist at three strengths rather than as single items. I could not confirm the individual tier names.

records.title: Blood Infusion
records.summary: A crafted refill for the vampiric blood reserve, paid for in Corruption.
bodyParagraphs: Three Blood Infusion recipes sit inside the health category, and they are the only crafted items that touch the vampiric side of the health system. They restore the blood reserve directly, but the refill is bought with Corruption rather than ingredients alone.
That cost is what makes them a deliberate choice instead of a free heal, since Corruption drives the game's night-side progression and consequences.
No ingredient lists or restore values were published in anything I could reach.
records.note: Sources treat this as a three-strength family rather than one item, so individual in-game names may differ.

records.summary: A base crafting component looted from containers, called for by nine different recipes.
bodyParagraphs: Linseed Oil is one of the two workhorse base components in the crafting list, appearing in nine recipes. Weak Spirits, in ten, is the other.
It is not gathered from the world like herbs; it comes out of containers. Crates and barrels around Vale Sangora are the usual source, so it accumulates naturally while looting.
Because so many recipes lean on it, it is worth opening containers even when your inventory feels full.

records.title: Weak Spirits
records.howToGet: Looted from crates and barrels, including throughout Vale Sangora.
records.summary: The most-used base component in the crafting list, required by ten recipes.
bodyParagraphs: Weak Spirits appears in more recipes than any other single component, which makes it the thing most likely to run short mid-run.
Like Linseed Oil it is container loot rather than a world-gathered plant, showing up regularly in crates and barrels around Vale Sangora.
The name implies a stronger counterpart exists, matching the pattern where most crafting ideas appear at three strengths, but no source I could reach confirmed one.
records.note: The existence of a stronger spirits variant is inferred from the naming pattern and is not recorded as fact.

No specific recipe, price or source location was stated in anything I could reach.

records.title: Strong Ancient Reagent
records.howToGet: Recovered from Ancient Ruins.
records.summary: A high-grade reagent pulled out of Ancient Ruins, and one of the three parts of the Razkovniche Elixir.
bodyParagraphs: One Strong Ancient Reagent is required for the Razkovniche Elixir, which makes finding one a prerequisite for the only permanent consumable in the game.

Ancient Ruins are the stated source. The name places it at the top of an ancient reagent line, consistent with the three-strength pattern running through the rest of the crafting list, though no weaker version was named in anything I could reach.

records.title: Tatzelwurm Gland
records.howToGet: Harvested from slain Tatzelwurms.
records.summary: A monster part cut from Tatzelwurms, needed two at a time for the Razkovniche Elixir.
bodyParagraphs: The Razkovniche Elixir calls for two of these, so the recipe demands at least one Tatzelwurm hunt before it can be brewed.
Tatzelwurms also guard other points of interest, notably the dig site holding the Knightly Ring near the Tantari Bog shrine, so the gland tends to accumulate alongside other errands.

records.title: Razkovniche Plant
records.howToGet: Obtainable only through The Hedgehog Herb side quest, which begins at an abandoned house.
records.summary: The legendary hedgehog herb, available exactly once per playthrough through its own side quest.
bodyParagraphs: This is the ingredient that makes the Razkovniche Elixir a one-time reward. The Hedgehog Herb quest is its only source, so once it is used the elixir cannot be brewed again.

The quest starts at an abandoned house, and the recipe for the elixir is pinned to the north-western wall of the dead alchemist's home inside the same questline, which means the plant and the instructions are found on the same trip.

records.title: Bandit's Treasure Map: Tantari Woods
records.howToGet: Recovered from bandits in and around Tantari Woods.
records.summary: A bandit treasure map whose marked dig site yields the legendary Knightly Ring.
bodyParagraphs: Treasure maps mark buried caches that need a shovel to open. This one points at the mound east of the Tantari Bog shrine, across a small wooden bridge.

The payout is the Knightly Ring, which means players who find the map and players who simply know the location both end up at the same hole in the ground. The ring can be dug up at any level but cannot be worn until Coen reaches level 9.
records.note: Guides name the map as an alternative route to the Knightly Ring; where the map itself is found was not stated in anything I could reach.

sources.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker: How to Get the Knightly Ring Early
Knightly Ring Location - Game8

records.title: Shovel
records.howToGet: Taken from the wooden shed in Parlita.
records.summary: The digging tool needed to open buried treasure sites, stolen from a shed in Parlita.
bodyParagraphs: Buried caches cannot be opened bare-handed, so the shovel is a prerequisite for treasure map rewards. The one guides point at is stored in a wooden shed in Parlita and has to be stolen.
The best-documented use is the mound east of the Tantari Bog shrine, which holds the Knightly Ring.
records.note: Only one dig site was documented in the sources I could reach; whether the shovel is a unique item or a common tool was not stated.

records.title: Anca's Recipe
records.howToGet: Given by Anca during the prologue, when she sends Coen to prepare her medicine.
records.summary: The prologue herb recipe from Anca, which asks for a precise number of spoonfuls brewed into water.
bodyParagraphs: Before the crafting system proper opens up, the prologue has Coen prepare a medicine to Anca's instructions. The puzzle is the measurement: the recipe specifies how many spoonfuls of herbs go into the water, and guides exist purely to answer that question.
It functions as the narrative introduction to brewing, with the Minor Mending Ointment tutorial following once the crafting panel unlocks after the prologue.
records.note: Covered by several walkthroughs of the prologue herb-brewing step; the exact spoonful count was not visible in the results I could read, so it is not recorded here.
